protect-your-family-your-business-and-yo.content:
A growing family, a new home, or changes in your business can affect your insurance needs. Reviewing your life, disability, and critical illness coverage can help protect your financial future.

For business owners, corporate-owned life insurance may also support succession planning, provide funds for estate obligations, and help transfer wealth to the next generation. The right strategy depends on your corporate structure, tax circumstances, and family goals.

Contact our office today to book an insurance and estate planning review.

business-payroll-ontario-minimum-wage-in.content:
Ontario Minimum Wage Increases to $17.95 per Hour

Ontario’s general minimum wage increased from $17.60 to $17.95 per hour on October 1, 2026. Business owners should review payroll settings and labour budgets to reflect the new rate. Different minimum wage rates apply to certain employee categories.

Need help updating your payroll? Contact our accounting team.
